searchText: **CONSIGNMENT** Used Newmar RV for sale - 2017 Newmar Ventana 4037 is approximately 40' 10' in length with 51,658 miles and 3 slides. Features Call for details More About This RV The Ventana 4037 class A diesel motor coach by Newmar offers triple slide outs, a rear master bath, and a half bath. As you enter the motor home, to the left is a slide with a 74' jack-knife sofa, overhead cabinets, LED TV on power lift, pull-out cabinet, kitchen countertop space, pull-out cabinet, three burner range, double kitchen sink, and overhead cabinets for dishes and things. On the opposite side there is a full wall slide stretching from the living/kitchen space to the master bedroom. The slide out features a 92' side hide-a-bed sofa, overhead storage, booth dinette, pantry, refrigerator, dual wardrobes, chest of drawers, and a bedroom TV. The driver and passenger's chairs rotate to provide more seating in the living space. A convenient half bath for guests and extra family members is located next to the kitchen area. There is a corner sink, medicine cabinet, toilet, and a linen cabinet. Heading towards the rear of the coach, you will first need to slide open the master bedroom door to see a king bed slide with overhead cabinets and nightstands on one side, and a chest of drawers, dual wardrobes, and bedroom TV on the full wall slide mentioned above. As you continue through the bedroom, the master bath is in the rear of the coach offering a corner shower and a toilet, plus on the rear wall there is a sink in between a wardrobe with a bi-fold door and an additional wardrobe, or choose an optional washer and dryer in its place. There are plenty of overhead cabinets throughout the motor home to store your non-perishables, dishes, camping gear, and even souvenirs, plus so much more!
